doc: The function called WITHOUT min_texels: the Python default 4.0 (4 texels per wavelength at the equator), so fmax = width / (8 pi): widths 0 (gives 0), 1, 7, 64, 256, 512, 1000, 4096, 8192, 16384, 65536 and 1e9. A default of 3 or 2 changes every nonzero row by 33% or 100%. Closed-form float64: rtol 1e-9.
